en.askTitle: Enter your own family, start date and offers and get the same Dubai health-cover comparison
en.runTitle: Moving to Dubai in January 2027: health cover for a wife and two children

fields.label: Family ages and sponsorship
fields.value: Wife and two children aged 4 and 8 on my residence visa; salary AED 28,000 a month, and my employer insures only me

fields.label: Neighbourhood and preferred clinics
fields.placeholder: e.g. Dubai Marina, with a children’s clinic within 15 minutes

fields.label: Written offers and full schedules
fields.placeholder: e.g. two broker offers with the full benefit schedules attached

fields.label: Family-specific needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. maternity cover, dental work for a child, a regular asthma prescription

en.template: Help compare Dubai-compliant cover for {family}, starting {date}, near {area}. Use {offers} to compare all-in premiums, networks, co-pays, medicines and {needs}. Keep missing terms visible. Ask before contacting anyone, submitting forms or sharing personal documents.

phases.title: Look up the official Dubai rules and published plan prices
phases.note: Health authority benefit schedule, laws on who must pay, and insurer price lists
phases.judgment: It used the current official benefit schedule rather than older brochures: the yearly medicines limit is AED 2,500 including co-payment, not the AED 1,500 some older documents show.

phases.title: Write the guide and a dated list of sources and calculations
phases.judgment: When the reviewer pointed out that the suggested yearly budget wasn’t backed by a named plan, the guide said so: a reliable current premium for enhanced family cover could not be established, and the extra price list it found is labelled as historical.

phases.title: Fill in the guide from the research gathered
Open the page on desktop and phone and check it
Hand over the files and list what stays unresolved
phases.note: Pricing gaps and research limits stated openly
phases.judgment: It disclosed a process problem instead of hiding it: some research fell back to a browser that was already open, so it could not be certified as done in a fresh, signed-out browser.

workers: Read the current official Dubai health authority benefit schedule, the rules for dependants and the circulars that replaced older ones
Found real named family health plans with published prices and noted what each price leaves out
Independently audited the finished guide and the source list against the original questions
